import sys
import time
import os

def main():
    start = time.time()
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    
    inner = False
    length = 0
    max_outside = 0
    inside_words = 0
    
    for c in s:
        if c == '_' or c == '(' or c == ')':
            if inner:
                if length > 0:
                    inside_words += 1
            else:
                if length > max_outside:
                    max_outside = length
            if c == '(':
                inner = True
            elif c == ')':
                inner = False
            length = 0
        else:
            length += 1
    
    # Handle last word
    if inner:
        if length > 0:
            inside_words += 1
    else:
        if length > max_outside:
            max_outside = length
    
    print(f"{max_outside} {inside_words}")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    
    if os.environ.get("ONLINE_JUDGE") is None:
        elapsed = (time.time() - start) * 1000
        print(f"[{elapsed:.0f}ms]")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
